content.title: Knoxville News Sentinel
content.text: Tennessee coach Kim Caldwell said she turned to a Plan B, and it led to the worst season of her career and for Lady Vols basketball. See link below Provided by Kate Luffman/Tennessee Athletics, Kate Luffman/Tennessee Athletics436Dave SmithWhat made Pat so special in my opinion was that she could transform players into fierce competitors. It’s a gift. Bear Bryant and General Neyland had that gift also. And the ability to meld everyone into a cohesive team.7Kathy Reed McInturfEveryone is a coach! We have a great group of upcoming sophomores and some others as well as a great incoming class! Support these girls and coach! One of the best and worst things about Tennessee is the fans!!! My college roommate was from Kentucky way back in the early 70s. I never heard her or her put down their coaches or teams like Tennessee does!!!402Carol DonathThey might have won had Barker not been sick. Cooper was great but needed some help as well. Hard to watch!12Mark McCuistonShe needs to go back to her style. Players need to know what that style is and recruit players that fit and want to be here in that style. She sacrificed what built her and got her here and we see how that turned out. Can’t let the inmates run the asylum. Stick to your guns coach.13Charles TrittPlan C: Moving van arrives at her house Monday morning!12Roger CunninghamShe’s brutally honest. She’s a great young coach. We need to keep her.64Chris DillsSeason is over let’s wait and see how she adjusts next year. I hope she turns it around and gets us going even better than her first season23
